input: Write a due diligence memo on Rippling

business.claim: Rippling describes itself as a workforce-management platform unifying HR, IT, finance and more on a single employee-data source, integrated with 600+ apps.
The company says its platform covers HR, payroll, IT, finance/spend, custom applications and AI; its Series G announcement said it offered over two dozen products across HR, IT and Spend.
Rippling's current global product messaging says customers can hire in 180+ countries and ship devices to 130+ countries; it offers global payroll, EOR, contractor and global-HRIS products.

Aggregator estimate: revenue is primarily subscription-based per-employee/per-month pricing across modules, with additional transaction revenue from FX, instant wage transfers and corporate-card interchange.

traction.claim: Rippling had over 20,000 customers and more than 4,000 employees as of the May 2025 financing coverage; TechCrunch also reported that the company said it worked with over 15,000 startups, including Cursor, Clay and Sierra.
Named customer references on Rippling's own site include Y Combinator, Barry's, Kleiner Perkins, Blank Street Coffee, Clay and CookUnity; these are company-published customer stories or testimonials.
Company claim: Rippling's careers page currently displays 6k+ global employees, $35B in payroll processed, 30k employee devices managed and 600+ app integrations.
Aggregator estimate: Rippling's PEO business had 99.5% year-over-year client retention as of fall 2024, and net revenue retention was approaching 200% as of the source's 2025 profile.

team.claim: Rippling's current official leadership page lists Parker Conrad as Co-Founder and CEO; Matt MacInnis as President and CPO; Albert Strasheim as CTO; Adam Swiecicki as CFO; Matt Plank as CRO; and Bridget Abraham as Chief Compliance Officer.
Company announcement: Albert Strasheim joined as CTO and SVP of Engineering after more than five years as VP of Engineering at Segment; Segment was acquired by Twilio for $3.2B in 2020.
Company announcement: Adam Swiecicki joined as CFO from Brex, where he was also CFO; earlier roles included Viking Global, Hellman & Friedman and Morgan Stanley.

Forbes identifies Parker Conrad as Rippling co-founder and CEO and reports that he previously founded/led Zenefits and co-founded SigFig/Wikinvest; Forbes also says he resigned under pressure as Zenefits CEO amid compliance investigations related to insurance sales.
Aggregator profile: Prasanna Sankar co-founded Rippling and is described as its former CTO; the current official leadership page does not list him, but an exact departure date was not verified.

funding.claim: Rippling's official announcement says it raised $450M in Series G financing on May 9, 2025, signed agreements to repurchase up to $200M of employee equity, and was valued at $16.8B; named investors included Elad Gil, Sands Capital, GIC, Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Baillie Gifford and Y Combinator.
TechCrunch reported that the Series G brought total raised to $1.85B and described the company as having raised $450M at a $16.8B valuation.
Fireround aggregator record: Series F was $200M at a $13.5B valuation, announced April 22, 2024.
Reuters reported a $500M funding round in March 2023 at an $11.25B valuation, led by Greenoaks.
Reuters reported a $250M Series D in May 2022 at an $11.25B valuation, led by Bedrock Capital and Kleiner Perkins.

financial_signals.claim: Company claim: Parker Conrad wrote on April 15, 2026 that Rippling revenue was growing 78% year over year at ARR above $1B, and that the growth rate had increased for three consecutive quarters.
Aggregator estimate: Sacra estimated $1B in annualized revenue in March 2026, up from $850M at year-end 2025, with 78% year-over-year growth.
TechCrunch reported approximately $570M in annualized revenue based on sources cited by The Information as of May 2025.

Company claim: Conrad wrote in March 2026 that he ran payroll for approximately 5,000 global Rippling employees; the current careers page separately displays 6k+ global employees, so the two company-published figures should be reconciled by date/definition.

Company careers page currently displays 3x year-over-year revenue growth, $35B payroll processed, 6k+ global employees and $1.4B+ raised to date; these are company-published dashboard figures, not audited financial statements.

legal_and_regulatory.claim: Rippling filed a federal lawsuit against Deel on March 17, 2025 alleging trade-secret theft, racketeering, unfair competition and a corporate-espionage campaign involving a Rippling employee; these are Rippling's allegations, not adjudicated findings.

CourtListener's federal docket for People Center, Inc. v. Deel, Inc. shows the case remained active on November 9, 2026, including a transcript and an opposition/response filed that day; a November 7 discovery order and November 6 forensic-inspection order are also listed.

The same docket shows Deel filed second amended counterclaims against Parker Conrad, Keith O'Brien and People Center, Inc. on November 4, 2026, so Rippling is also a defendant/counterclaim party in the continuing dispute.

reputation.claim: Glassdoor snapshot: 3.6/5 from 1,313 reviews, 66% would recommend Rippling, 79% approve of Parker Conrad as CEO and 74% report a positive business outlook; category scores shown include 3.0 for senior management and 3.4 for culture and values.

Glassdoor's AI summary describes a high-ownership, high-standards culture and fast pace, but also reports that some employees cite burnout risk, intense workload and low support when conditions change quickly; this is review-site content, not an independent workforce survey.

Trustpilot snapshot: 4.6/5 from 2,763 reviews; its recent-review summary praises usability and convenience but notes complaints about disorganized or complex implementation and occasional technical glitches.

red_flags.claim: Material litigation remains active: the Rippling-v.-Deel case had discovery activity, sealed filings, forensic-inspection orders and counterclaims as of November 9, 2026; the merits remain unresolved.

Reconcile company-published capital figures: the careers page displays $1.4B+ raised to date, while TechCrunch and the Fireround funding record report $1.85B total after Series G; this may reflect timing or scope differences but is not explained on the pages reviewed.
Growth and ARR figures are not audited in the sources reviewed: the $1B+ ARR and 78% growth figures are CEO/company claims, while Sacra labels its $1B estimate as an estimate.

Employee-reputation diligence warrants follow-up: Glassdoor shows only 66% would recommend and a 3.0 senior-management score, while its summary flags burnout/intense workload; Trustpilot notes implementation complexity and technical glitches.

Founder-background risk: Forbes reports Parker Conrad's prior Zenefits CEO tenure ended amid compliance investigations related to insurance sales; this is historical background about a prior company, not evidence of a Rippling regulatory violation.

output.verdict: Rippling presents a strong first-pass profile: a broad, unified HR/IT/finance platform, named enterprise and startup customers, rapid reported growth, substantial funding and a current leadership bench that includes experienced Segment and Brex executives. The investment team should go deeper on audited revenue, gross margin and cash burn, reconcile conflicting employee/funding figures, test the durability of retention and cross-sell claims, and assess exposure and legal spend from the still-active Deel litigation.
missing_fields: audited financial statements, profitability, gross margin, cash balance and burn
verified cap table and primary-source historical funding documents beyond the reported rounds
exact departure date and circumstances for former CTO/co-founder Prasanna Sankar
comprehensive list of notable executive departures in the last two years
independent, comprehensive regulatory-enforcement search for Rippling and its licensed affiliates
verified Rippling data-breach history and incident disclosures
complete court-docket merits/outcome and damages exposure for the Deel litigation
independently verified current customer count, retention, NRR and geographic revenue mix
